task_dispatch.objective: Perform a read-only architectural analysis of the R21 Seminar Controller and Presentation Rubrics Backend migration and determine the concrete implementation slices required to achieve legacy functional parity in CampusLynk.
instructions: Inspect the legacy R21 Seminar controller, related presentation/rubric views, routes, models, migrations, services, and tests needed to establish the complete functional contract.
Inspect the current CampusLynk target-side controllers, models, services, routes, and existing R21 Major Project implementation for reusable patterns and shared domain contracts.

Identify every legacy endpoint, action, validation rule, calculation, rubric structure, persistence operation, authorization requirement, response type, and relevant relationship that belongs to M2.4.

Determine which target artifacts already exist and which are genuinely missing. Do not create replacement models, services, components, or infrastructure when an existing CampusLynk implementation can satisfy the requirement.
Compare legacy and target database/schema support and identify any genuinely missing migrations or model relationships. Do not modify the database during analysis.

Inspect existing design-system and UI architecture only where it affects backend contracts or future presentation/rubric integration. Any eventual staff/dashboard UI must use the appropriate existing app-shell/faculty-shell and x-ui.* components; do not design duplicate UI infrastructure.
Decompose the implementation into safe, independently verifiable slices with exact candidate file whitelists, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and rollback/stop conditions.
Identify risks involving data parity, grading/rubric calculations, authorization, existing shared services, route collisions, or coupling with completed R21 Major Project functionality.
Return a TASK_REPORT only. Do not implement the migration.
constraints: READ-ONLY ANALYSIS ONLY; do not modify application files.
Do not modify routes, controllers, models, services, Blade views, migrations, tests, STATE.json, FEATURE_MATRIX.md, or any other repository files.
Do not execute database migrations or destructive database operations.
Do not create duplicate global UI components, shells, grading infrastructure, or services.

Any eventual virtual classroom/studio UI must use <x-layouts.workspace-layout>; staff-facing dashboards must use <x-layouts.app-shell> or <x-layouts.faculty-shell>; print output must use <x-layouts.report-layout>.
Reuse existing <x-ui.*> components wherever UI becomes part of the approved migration scope.
Do not expand scope into unrelated R21 units or later dependency branches.
Do not commit or alter persistent migration state.
task_dispatch.expected_report: A read-only M2.4 architecture TASK_REPORT containing: legacy source files and target files inspected; complete endpoint/functionality inventory; models/schema/services involved; legacy-to-target parity gaps; authorization and validation requirements; reusable existing CampusLynk infrastructure; route dependencies and collision risks; proposed implementation slices with exact candidate file whitelists; test and verification strategy; risks and ambiguities; and the recommended first implementation slice for architect approval.
stop_conditions: Stop immediately if implementation changes are required to continue the analysis.
Stop if the analysis indicates that M2.4 requires an architectural decision not already covered by the migration control plane; report the decision point instead of choosing autonomously.
Stop after the complete read-only architecture and decomposition analysis.
Return only the TASK_REPORT for architect review.
